mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing albendazole metabolism and reducing its antihelmintic efficacy, while ginkgo's antiplatelet effects could theoretically increase bleeding risk with albendazole's rare hematologic adverse effects.
action: Monitor therapeutic efficacy of albendazole treatment; consider spacing administration times and counseling patient on bleeding precautions; verify adequate parasitic clearance.
